meaning_of_acceptance: AI-assisted mathematical acceptance of the exact bound artifacts; no external human peer review, journal acceptance, or formal proof-assistant certification.
prior_credit: The basic counterexample is credited to Fu-Zhou Gong and Li-Ming Wu in Gong–Liu–Wen (2013), Section 3, printed page 495. No novelty or priority asserted.
accepted_claims: For every 0<a<1 the compact Bernoulli-prepending chain has exact coarse curvature 1−a, unique full-support invariant probability, and Feller property.
The complex mean-zero L2 spectrum is the closed unit disk, spectral radius and all positive-power norms are one, while each fixed mean-zero observable converges strongly to zero.
No finite variance bound holds for any of the three explicitly defined ordinary, residual, and conditional-variance energies; cylinder witnesses are Lipschitz.
Infinite topological irreducibility holds, but measure/Harris irreducibility does not.
Finite truncations are irreducible and aperiodic, with mean-zero nilpotence and exact ordinary Poincaré gap 1−cos(π/(L+1)).
Strong finite-rank approximation preserves uniform positive coarse curvature but not spectral-radius bounds absent further uniform control.
Under the explicit prepending convention PP*=I, and the printed P*P=I identity fails; the known spectral-radius conclusion remains independently correct.
The pinned Erbar–Fathi v1 source is finite, irreducible, reversible, continuous-time, and entropic-curvature based; it does not support the attributed nonreversible coarse-curvature extension.
excluded_claims: No resolution of all of open-ended Problem E or of all possible additional hypotheses.
No counterexample inside an additionally required Harris/measure-irreducible class.
No denial of reversible spectral-gap or nonlocal blurred-gradient inequalities.
No universal failure of stronger finite-approximation frameworks.
No official erratum, false final published spectral-radius theorem, or authorial-intent claim.
No exhaustive or latest-version literature audit; source inspection was limited to the recorded statements and locations.
mathematical_preservation: PROOF.md is byte-identical to the accepted exposition. Four precisely mapped audit editorial changes address the title, AI-assistance disclosure, implementation reference, and publication-scope/exclusion paragraph; no audit mathematics is changed.
